messages.text: What are the most important S-parameters capabilities for applications in Aerospace / Defense?

The passages do not directly rank “the most important S-parameter capabilities” for Aerospace / Defense, but they support prioritizing these VNA/S-parameter-related capabilities for satellite payload and RF component testing: group delay and phase measurements, measurements on converters/mixers/amplifiers/filters/antennas, noise figure and gain, wide frequency coverage, 2-port/4-port support, high measurement accuracy, dynamic range, pulsed-signal support, and time-domain / distance-to-fault functions.[13][14][16][17][19][20][25][28][32][33][41][43]
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite payload group delay testing is used to determine transmission-path phase distortions, frequency converter / transponder channel band-edge distortion, and transmission-path quality; R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing including group delay and phase measurements.[6][20] | [6][20] |
| Frequency-converting DUT support | The passages describe group delay methods for satellite transponders, frequency converters and other components, and state that R&S ZNA can measure embedded LO converter group delay and intermodulation with an optional second source.[32][34] | [32][34] |
| Component-level RF coverage | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing, especially converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements.[20] | [20] |
| Wide frequency range | R&S ZNA26 covers 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, while R&S ZNA43 covers 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| 2-port / 4-port S-parameter capability | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 are available with 2 or 4 test ports.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| High measurement resolution and dense sweeps | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 have 1 Hz frequency resolution and 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| Measurement bandwidth / speed headroom | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 have base-unit measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz, or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| Measurement accuracy | R&S ZNA26 transmission uncertainty examples include 0.04 dB / 0.7° from >200 MHz to 10 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission, and 0.05 dB / 1.3° from >10 GHz to 26.5 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission, under the stated calibration and measurement conditions.[46] | [46] |
| Dynamic range | R&S ZNL20 dynamic range is specified as >110 dB from 10 MHz to 14 GHz, >105 dB from 14 GHz to 16 GHz, and >100 dB from 16 GHz to 20 GHz under the stated 0 dBm source power, 10 Hz bandwidth and no system error correction conditions.[28] | [28] |
| Pulsed-signal measurement option | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 software options include R&S ZNA-K7 measurements on pulsed signals.[13][16] | [13][16] |
| Noise figure and gain measurement | Satellite payload / component testing includes noise figure and gain measurements using R&S FS-SNS or R&S ZNA-K30, and R&S ZNA26 / ZNA43 list R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement as a software option.[13][16][19] | [13][16][19] |
| Time-domain and distance-to-fault capability | R&S ZNL20 firmware / software options include R&S ZNL-K2 Time domain analysis and R&S ZNL-K3 Distance-to-fault measurement.[25] | [25] |

| 項目 | R&S®ZNL20 規格 |
|---|---|

| Impedance | 50 Ω |
| Test port connector | 3.5 mm, male |
| Number of test ports | 2 |
| Frequency resolution | 1 Hz |
| Measurement points | 1 to 100001 per trace |
| Measurement bandwidth | 1 Hz to 500 kHz，1/1.5/2/3/5/7 sequence |
| Standard aging per year | ±1 × 10⁻⁶ |
| Aging per year with R&S®FPL1-B4 | ±1 × 10⁻⁷ |
| Standard temperature drift, +5 °C to +40 °C | ±1 × 10⁻⁶ |
| Temperature drift with R&S®FPL1-B4, +5 °C to +40 °C | ±1 × 10⁻⁸ |
| Achievable initial calibration accuracy standard | ±5 × 10⁻⁷ |

| Test port input maximum nominal input level | 0 dBm |
| Test port input damage level | +27 dBm |
| Test port input damage DC voltage | 30 V |

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis 主要條件（摘錄）
- [[R&S ZNL20-B1]] 的 spectrum analysis frequency range 為 5 kHz to 26.5 GHz，高於 R&S®ZNL20 的 VNA frequency range 5 kHz to 20 GHz；本頁依來源分別記錄，不合併。
- R&S®ZNL20-K14 independent CW source maximum output frequency = 20 GHz。
- Second harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 13 GHz，≤ –20 dBc，typical –35 dBc。
- Third harmonics，source power –10 dBm：R&S®ZNL20，10 MHz to 8.5 GHz，≤ –25 dBc，typical –40 dBc。
- Frequency response referenced to 50 MHz，RF attenuation 0 dB/10 dB/20 dB/30 dB，+18 °C to +28 °C：10 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz < 0.8 dB（σ = 0.1 dB）；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz < 1.3 dB（σ = 0.2 dB）；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz < 2.0 dB（σ = 0.5 dB）；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz < 2.5 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz < 3.0 dB（σ = 0.66 dB）。
- Total measurement uncertainty 條件：signal level 0 dB to –50 dB below reference level、S/N > 20 dB、sweep time auto、sweep type sweep、RF attenuation 10 dB/20 dB/30 dB、span/RBW < 100、95 % confidence level、+18 °C to +28 °C。R&S®ZNL20：3 MHz < f ≤ 2.9 GHz 為 1 dB；2.9 GHz < f ≤ 6 GHz 為 1.5 dB；6 GHz < f ≤ 14 GHz 為 2.2 dB；14 GHz < f ≤ 20 GHz 為 2.7 dB；20 GHz < f ≤ 26.5 GHz 為 3.2 dB。

R&S ZNL20 › Spectrum analysis option
| Code | Order No. | 名稱 / 原文說明 | 相依 / 限制 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| R&S®ZNL20-B1 | 1303.8101.02 | Spectrum analysis，for R&S®ZNL20 | devices with serial number < 101200 cannot retrofit |

With R&S®ZNL20-B1 spectrum analysis option：

- Spectrum analysis frequency range：5 kHz to 26.5 GHz。
- RF input impedance：50 Ω。
- RF input connector：see section Measurement range, Test port connector，即 3.5 mm, male。
- Attenuator setting range：0 dB to 30 dB，10 dB steps。
- Frequency resolution：0.01 Hz。
- Number of sweep / trace points：default 1001；range 101 to 100001。
- Signal analysis bandwidth equalized：standard 10 MHz nominal；f < 6 GHz with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] option 為 40 MHz nominal；f ≥ 6 GHz with [[R&S FPL1-B40]] and [[R&S FPL1-B11]] options，YIG preselector off，為 40 MHz nominal。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- 衛星通訊系統需支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，並涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems。
- 衛星系統需要 24/7 operation、multi-decade system longevity 與 satellite life cycle 期間的 quality of service。
- 現代衛星系統需相容 existing cellular networks 與 emerging wireless technologies。
- 衛星設備製造商面臨 test time / cost 降低需求，同時 uplink beams 與 downlink beams 總數增加。
- 一個 uplink digital data stream 可能對應 multiple downlink streams，因此測試方案需 straightforward、fast、reproducible，且具備 high measurement performance 與 repeatability。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載與元件測試
[[衛星酬載與元件測試]]是針對 satellite transponders、payload subsystems、modules 與 RF / digital components 的設計、開發、驗證與 qualification 測試集合，來源以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器方案為主。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › Payload 架構層級
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 將 satellite payload 技術演進描述為：

- Bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads。
- Digital regenerative payloads。

Bent-pipe satellite payload channel 的 high-level components 包含：

- uplink antenna
- low noise amplifier
- filter
- frequency converter
- filter
- high power amplifier
- filter
- downlink antenna
- local oscillator

Regenerative payload channel 在上述鏈路中加入：

- digital demodulator
- baseband processing and switching
- digital modulator

來源稱 regenerative payloads 可提升 system capacity 與 flexibility，但會增加 testing complexity。

依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

Radiated Spurious Emissions
[[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]（RSE）是無線裝置在載波與必要頻寬之外，以輻射方式發出的 unwanted emissions 測試項目；本 vault 目前主要由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 與 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 支撐。

| 期間 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 2025–2028 | widespread deployment of 5G tactical networks；mmWave phased arrays available for field testing；hybrid commercial / military networks such as 5G.MIL-style architectures |
| 2028–2032 | 5G/6G-capable software-defined radios replacing multi-radio tactical stacks；early [[ISAC]] deployment for drone detection and perimeter defense；[[URLLC]] services for autonomy |
| 2032–2035+ | full 6G networks with integrated sensing；AI-native battlefield connectivity；high-precision location sensing and spectrum-aware autonomy |

來源也列出 [[5G.MIL]]、[[Raytheon OXYGEN]]、[[L3Harris Tactical Network Demo]]、[[DoD EMS Superiority Strategy]] 與 [[FutureG ISAC]] / spectrum sharing programs，作為 FHSS 與 5G convergence 的 program examples。

SMA100B_specs_en_5215-1018-22_v1000 › 重點摘要
- 來源為 Rohde & Schwarz R&S®SMA100B RF and Microwave Signal Generator 規格書，文件代碼 PD 5215.1018.22，Specifications Version 10.00，日期 February 2026；PDF 來源檔為 SMA100B_specs_en_5215-1018-22_v1000.pdf。
- [[R&S SMA100B]] 是 RF and Microwave Signal Generator，base unit Order No. 1419.8888.02；訂購時必須搭配一個 R&S®SMAB-B1xx frequency option，以及 R&S®SMAB-B92 或 R&S®SMAB-B93 platform height option。
- Frequency options 覆蓋 8 kHz to 3 GHz、6 GHz、12.75 GHz、20 GHz、31.8 GHz、40 GHz、50 GHz、67 GHz；67 GHz 型號有 overrange 67 GHz to 72 GHz。
- Product data 適用條件：在 ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後，warm-up operation 30 分鐘，符合指定 environmental conditions，遵守 recommended calibration interval，並執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。
- Key phase-noise claims：base unit 在 10 GHz、20 kHz offset 的 SSB phase noise 為 < –120 dBc typ.；搭配 R&S®SMAB-B711 option 時，在 10 GHz、10 kHz offset 為 < –132 dBc typ.；close-in SSB phase noise 在 f = 10 GHz、offset = 10 Hz 時為 < –83 dBc typ.；wideband noise 在 10 GHz、30 MHz offset 時為 < –162 dBc typ.。
- Output power key claims：6 GHz model 搭配 ultra high output power 可達 38 dBm；20 GHz model 在 18 GHz 超過 30 dBm、20 GHz 為 28 dBm；40 GHz model 在 20 GHz to 35 GHz 超過 30 dBm；67 GHz model 到 70 GHz 仍超過 20 dBm。
- 機箱高度可為 2 HU（R&S®SMAB-B92，5-inch touch display）或 3 HU（R&S®SMAB-B93，7-inch touch display）；high output power 在高頻 options 上多數需要 3 HU。
- Analog modulation、pulse modulation、chirped pulses、VOR/ILS、pulse train、power analysis、differential clock synthesizer、HUMS、remote control GPIB/USB 等功能由 R&S®SMAB-Kxxx 或 R&S®SMAB-Bxxx options 提供。
- Level、setting range 與 output power 規格依 frequency option、power option 與 serial number 分段；特別是 R&S®SMAB-B150/-B150N/-B167/-B167N 在 serial number < 120000 與 ≥ 120000 有不同 specified level range。

依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

[[2025-12-19 Making Deployed 5G Private Networks more Resilient]] 列出的 mission / market drivers 包含：

- tactical edge connectivity needs；
- rise of smart jamming and improved [[EW]] tactics；
- complex RF environment 與 contested spectrum；
- growing adoption of private 5G networks；
- autonomous systems and drones requiring low latency；
- expansion of tactical private 5G networks on military bases；
- demand for secure command-and-control networks；
- strategic partnerships，例如來源提到 Nokia + L3Harris in 2024；
- multi-year contracts，例如來源提到 Northrop Grumman 5G battlefield networking in 2024。

[[5G-hardening-against-smart-jammer-attacks_wp_en_3610-1591-52_v0100]] 另稱 United States Department of Defense has recently embarked on a strategy leveraging both public and private 5G networks，並說 5G could become the de-facto communications network between NATO members。此為 white paper statement；來源未附完整 DoD / NATO 文件引用。

- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

The passages do not directly rank “the most important S-parameter capabilities” for Aerospace / Defense, but they support prioritizing these VNA/S-parameter-related capabilities for satellite payload and RF component testing: group delay and phase measurements, measurements on converters/mixers/amplifiers/filters/antennas, noise figure and gain, wide frequency coverage, 2-port/4-port support, high measurement accuracy, dynamic range, pulsed-signal support, and time-domain / distance-to-fault functions.[13][14][16][17][19][20][25][28][32][33][41][43]
| Capability | Why it matters in the supported passages | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Group delay and phase measurement | Satellite payload group delay testing is used to determine transmission-path phase distortions, frequency converter / transponder channel band-edge distortion, and transmission-path quality; R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing including group delay and phase measurements.[6][20] | [6][20] |
| Frequency-converting DUT support | The passages describe group delay methods for satellite transponders, frequency converters and other components, and state that R&S ZNA can measure embedded LO converter group delay and intermodulation with an optional second source.[32][34] | [32][34] |
| Component-level RF coverage | R&S ZNA is recommended for component-level testing, especially converters, mixers, amplifiers, filters, antennas, noise figure, group delay and phase measurements.[20] | [20] |
| Wide frequency range | R&S ZNA26 covers 10 MHz to 26.5 GHz, while R&S ZNA43 covers 10 MHz to 43.5 GHz.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| 2-port / 4-port S-parameter capability | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 are available with 2 or 4 test ports.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| High measurement resolution and dense sweeps | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 have 1 Hz frequency resolution and 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| Measurement bandwidth / speed headroom | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 have base-unit measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz, or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 increased IF bandwidth.[14][17] | [14][17] |
| Measurement accuracy | R&S ZNA26 transmission uncertainty examples include 0.04 dB / 0.7° from >200 MHz to 10 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission, and 0.05 dB / 1.3° from >10 GHz to 26.5 GHz at 0 dB to –30 dB transmission, under the stated calibration and measurement conditions.[46] | [46] |
| Dynamic range | R&S ZNL20 dynamic range is specified as >110 dB from 10 MHz to 14 GHz, >105 dB from 14 GHz to 16 GHz, and >100 dB from 16 GHz to 20 GHz under the stated 0 dBm source power, 10 Hz bandwidth and no system error correction conditions.[28] | [28] |
| Pulsed-signal measurement option | R&S ZNA26 and R&S ZNA43 software options include R&S ZNA-K7 measurements on pulsed signals.[13][16] | [13][16] |
| Noise figure and gain measurement | Satellite payload / component testing includes noise figure and gain measurements using R&S FS-SNS or R&S ZNA-K30, and R&S ZNA26 / ZNA43 list R&S ZNA-K30 noise figure measurement as a software option.[13][16][19] | [13][16][19] |
| Time-domain and distance-to-fault capability | R&S ZNL20 firmware / software options include R&S ZNL-K2 Time domain analysis and R&S ZNL-K3 Distance-to-fault measurement.[25] | [25] |

衛星酬載群延遲量測
[[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]是用來判定 satellite communications transmission path phase distortions、frequency converter / transponder channel band edge distortion 與 transmission path quality 的測試方法集合。

R&S ZNA26 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA26]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options，例如 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode、[[R&S ZNA-K6]] phase coherent source control、[[R&S ZNA-K7]] measurements on pulsed signals、[[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support、[[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements、[[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement、[[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS。各 option 的 order no. 與相依關係見 [[R&S ZNA]]。

R&S ZNA26 › 基本規格
- Frequency range：10 MHz to 26.5 GHz。
- Test port connector：3.5 mm, male, ruggedized。
- Number of test ports：2 or 4。
- Impedance：50 Ω。
- DC block：standard。
- Frequency resolution：1 Hz。
- Number of measurement points per trace：1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；with [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。

R&S ZNA43 › Software options
[[R&S ZNA43]] 可使用 [[R&S ZNA]] 系列 software / measurement options，例如 [[R&S ZNA-K1]] spectrum analyzer mode、[[R&S ZNA-K6]] phase coherent source control、[[R&S ZNA-K7]] measurements on pulsed signals、[[R&S ZNA-K8]] mmWave converter support、[[R&S ZNA-K9]] group delay measurements、[[R&S ZNA-K30]] noise figure measurement、[[R&S ZNA-K980]] HUMS。各 option 的 order no. 與相依關係見 [[R&S ZNA]]。

R&S ZNA43 › 基本規格
- Frequency range：10 MHz to 43.5 GHz。
- Test port connector：2.4 mm, male, ruggedized 或 2.92 mm, male, ruggedized。
- Number of test ports：2 or 4。
- Impedance：50 Ω。
- DC block：standard。
- Frequency resolution：1 Hz。
- Number of measurement points per trace：1 to 100001。
- Measurement bandwidth：base unit 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz；with [[R&S ZNA-K17]] increased IF bandwidth 30 MHz option 時為 1 Hz to 30 MHz。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 主要 RF 測試項目
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]，satellite payload / components testing 主要涵蓋：

- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]]：判定 transmission path phase distortions 與 channel band edges distortion。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements：gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、ACLR、[[NPR]]、distortion。
- Signal quality measurements：modulation accuracy、[[BER]]、[[EVM]]、carrier-in-carrier interference analysis。
- [[OFDM]] signal generation and analysis：custom OFDM、DFT-s-OFDM、f-OFDM、UFMC、FBMC、GFDM。
- [[Spurious emissions]] measurements：wide frequency range、very low level spurs、narrow RBW 與 long measurement time 問題。
- [[Noise figure measurement]] and gain measurements：使用 [[R&S FS-SNS]] 或 [[R&S ZNA-K30]]。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]]：thermal vacuum chamber 下的 payload qualification 與 calibration / power measurement。
- Digital interface testing：[[SpaceWire]]、[[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus decode / trigger / debug。

衛星酬載與元件測試 › 儀器與測試角色
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]]：建議用於 complete payload testing，涵蓋 group delay、linearity、NPR、modulation、OFDM、spurious 與 signal quality。
- [[R&S ZNA]]：建議用於 component level testing，特別是 converters、mixers、amplifiers、filters、antennas、noise figure、group delay 與 phase measurements。
- [[R&S RTP]] 與 [[R&S RTO6]]：用於 satellite digital interface decode / trigger / debug。
- [[R&S ZN-Z33]]、[[R&S NRP33SN-V]]、[[R&S NRP67SN-V]]：用於 [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 的 inline calibration 與 chamber 內 power measurement。

R&S ZNL20 › Firmware / software options
| Code | Order No. | 名稱 / 原文說明 | Requires / 限制 |
|---|---:|---|---|
| R&S®ZNL-K2 | 1323.1819.02 | Time domain analysis | 來源未標示 |
| R&S®ZNL-K3 | 1323.1825.02 | Distance-to-fault measurement | 來源未標示 |
| R&S®ZNL-K14 | 1303.8182.02 | Independent CW source | available for R&S®ZNL20；requires spectrum analysis option；R&S®ZNL20-K14 maximum output frequency = 20 GHz |
| R&S®FPL1-K7 | 1323.1731.02 | AM/FM/PM measurement demodulator | requires spectrum analysis option |
| R&S®FPL1-K9 | 1323.1754.02 | Power sensor measurement with R&S®NRP power sensors | requires spectrum analysis option；僅適用 average power measurement |
| R&S®FPL1-K30 | 1323.1760.02 | Noise figure and gain measurements | requires spectrum analysis option and R&S®FPL1-B5 additional interface option |

R&S ZNL20 › Dynamic range
條件：0 dBm source power；transmission magnitude data trace RMS value；test ports short-circuited；10 Hz measurement bandwidth；without system error correction。使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。

| Frequency range | Specification | Typical |
|---|---:|---:|
| 5 kHz to 100 kHz | > 85 dB | 110 dB |
| 100 kHz to 10 MHz | > 100 dB | 120 dB |
| 10 MHz to 14 GHz | > 110 dB | 120 dB |
| 14 GHz to 16 GHz | > 105 dB | 120 dB |
| 16 GHz to 20 GHz | > 100 dB | 117 dB |

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的適用性與優點
- 適合 unstable LOs 的 frequency converting DUTs，因 DUT internal LO 的 frequency 與 phase deviations 可落在 IF bandwidth 範圍內，最高到 several MHz。
- New internal combiner 可簡化 measurement setup，兩個 signals 不再需要 external connection。
- Two-port [[R&S ZNA]] 搭配 optional second source，可量測 embedded LO converter group delay 與 intermodulation。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 的 two independent LOs for internal receivers 可讓 mixers 的 RF/IF 同時量測。
- Measurement speeds 為 single LO 的兩倍，並降低 conversion loss 與 group delay measurements 的 trace noise。
- 除 group delay 外，也可透過 integrating group delay 計算 relative phase 與 deviation from linear phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S ZNA]] 使用 two-tone stimulus signal。
- 儀器量測 DUT input 與 output 的兩個 signals 之 phase difference。
- Group delay 由 phase difference 與 frequency offset 計算。
- 兩個 signals 間的 frequency offset Δf 是 aperture。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 具備用於量測不同 frequency signals 之 phase 的 frontend。
- Calibration 只需要 unknown through mixer。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法一：R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A multi-carrier group delay measurement
[[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]] 說 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 與 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 可用於快速、直接量測 satellite transponders、frequency converters 與 other components 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。

R&S ZNL › Measurement speed（VNA）
Measurement time 條件：sweep type CW、center frequency 1 GHz、measurement S11、bandwidth selectivity normal、number of points 201。

| Measurement bandwidth | Time per sweep T_SWEEP | Sweep cycle time T_CYCLE | Preparation time per point T_PREP | Acquisition time per point T_ACQ | Total time per point T_POINT |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 500 kHz | 920 µs | 1.6 ms meas. | 0.6 µs | 4.0 µs | 4.6 µs |
| 100 kHz | 2.65 ms | 3.6 ms meas. | 0.6 µs | 12.7 µs | 13.2 µs |

Data transfer time 條件：sweep type CW、center frequency 1 GHz、measurement S11、bandwidth 500 kHz、selectivity normal、over 1 Gbit/s LAN。

| 5001 | 46 ms meas. | 31 ms meas. | 31 ms meas. | 18 ms meas. | 3.5 ms meas. | 3.5 ms meas. |

Continuous mode 不需要額外 data transfer time，因為 data transfer 與 measurement 同時進行。

R&S ZNL › Dynamic range
Dynamic range 定義為 0 dBm source power 與 transmission magnitude data trace RMS value 的差；data trace 由 test ports short-circuited 時的 noise 與 crosstalk 產生。規格條件為 10 Hz measurement bandwidth、without system error correction。使用 1 Hz measurement bandwidth 可增加 dynamic range。

R&S®ZNA26 measurement accuracy 的有效條件：+18 °C to +28 °C；calibration 後溫度變化不超過 1 °C；使用 R&S®ZN-Z235 calibration kit；frequency points、measurement bandwidth、sweep time 必須與 measurement 和 calibration 相同；不使用 interpolation of the calibration；base unit without options 條件為 measurement bandwidth 10 Hz、nominal source power 0 dBm。
